newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in Philips vault on good Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Philips vault on good Q2 results.

text.p: Shares in Dutch electronics giant Philips rose sharply on the Amsterdam stock exchange on Thursday after the company reported much higher than expected second quarter net profits.
Philips shares, which traded up strongly on Wednesday ahead of the results, jumped 14.90 guilders, more than eight percent, at the open on Thursday.

Net profit from ordinary operations rose to 693 million guilders in the second quarter of 1997 from 304 million in the same period of 1996. Analysts had expected profits in a range between 429 and 540 million guilders.

"The results are much better than expected and what is surprising is the enormous improvement in Europe. The loss in the United States was to be expected. We will increase our earnings estimates for the company," said analyst Steven Vrolijk of ING Barings.
